exposure: complementary feeding bottles given at maternity hospital
feeding bottles during the first month of life
avoidance of dairy products during pregnancy or breastfeeding
intake of antibiotics by the infant
consumption of proton-pump inhibitors or antacids by the infant during the first month of life
cohort: The study included 554 infants diagnosed with CMA (cases) and 211 controls, all aged 6-9 months and breastfed for at least 1 month.
finding: Complementary bottles given at maternity hospital, family history of allergy, and avoidance of dairy products during pregnancy or breastfeeding were independent risk factors for cow's milk allergy in breastfed infants.
